layman_headline: SOL is nearing its profit target — sit tight and let winners run while the market catches its breath.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive rally week, with almost everything up 20-90% in seven days. Our Solana position is up 9.2% and approaching our $100 exit target. Our XRP position is slightly underwater but well above its stop-loss. Every new candidate on the watchlist has already surged dramatically, making fresh entries very risky right now — we'd be chasing momentum at extended prices.
layman_action: Don't buy anything new right now. Watch SOL closely for a move toward $100 to take profits. Keep XRP unless it drops below $1.30. Wait for a pullback before opening any new positions.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates are severely extended after 7-day moves ranging from +27% to +89%. PUMP has an RSI of 86, deeply overbought. MON, STX, ZRO, and XRP have all moved 40-89% in a week with no pullback — entering now would be chasing with poor risk/reward. BTC dominance at 59.1% continues to suppress altcoin relative performance. The Fear & Greed index dropped from 71 to 66, suggesting the initial euphoria may be fading. The prudent move is to manage existing positions: SOL at $95.33 is within striking distance of our $100 target, while XRP at $1.50 is down 3.8% from entry but has substantial room above its $1.30 stop. No new entry offers a clean setup with defined downside.
risk_factors: Market-wide euphoria with Greed sentiment could reverse sharply, dragging all positions down simultaneously
BTC dominance at 59.1% signals capital rotation back to Bitcoin, pressuring alt positions like SOL and XRP
XRP's 49.5% weekly gain hasn't benefited our position (entered at $1.56), suggesting we caught the tail end of the move
watch_list: SOL price action near $100 resistance — look to take profits if it touches or exceeds target
XRP behavior relative to $1.40 support — if it loses this level, consider tightening stop-loss from $1.30
Any pullback in MON or STX toward 38.2% Fibonacci retracement for potential new entry with better risk/reward
market_context: The crypto market just experienced a historic weekly rally with BTC up 22% and alts up 25-90%. Fear & Greed at 66 (Greed) but declining from yesterday's 71 suggests momentum may be peaking short-term.
context_banner: After a massive market-wide rally, all new candidates are overextended — discipline demands patience while managing existing winners toward their targets.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 66 but declining from 71, suggesting initial rally euphoria is cooling — not ideal for fresh entries.
PUMP RSI at 86 exemplifies how overbought swing candidates are; most have moved 40-89% in 7 days with no retracement.
XRP headline about Treasury buyback and curve control hopes explains the 49.5% weekly rally but suggests the news is already priced in.
Massive volume across the board (BTC $28.5B, ETH $15.4B, XRP $5.6B) confirms the rally is real but also suggests short-term exhaustion is likely.
Ray Dalio recommending Bitcoin amid debt crisis fears provides macro tailwind but BTC dominance at 59.1% means this benefits BTC more than alts.
